lines.text: Here's a simple follow-up workflow that runs on its own.
A new lead comes in. A text goes out in under a minute.
No reply? A call reminder and an email go out the next day.
When they book, the follow-up stops automatically.
Leads that go quiet get a friendly check-in after thirty days.
